destructive.title: Confirm deletion
destructive.warning: This action cannot be undone. Type the word "{{word}}" below to confirm.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: Times are stored in the local timezone. Default duration — {{minutes}} minutes.
meeting.delete_confirm: This meeting will be deleted. Its protocol (if any) — too.

fields.history_empty: History is empty — the field has not been edited yet.

unlock.setup_hint: This password encrypts the database. It cannot be recovered.
unlock.unlock_hint: The database cannot be opened without the password.
unlock.error_min_length: Password must be at least {{min}} characters
unlock.error_predictable: Password is too predictable — add unique words or symbols

client.title: Client
client.age_invalid: Age must be an integer between 0 and 120
client.create_description: Only the full name is required — the rest can be filled in later on the client page. All changes will be reflected in the client's timeline.
client.archive_confirm: Client "{{name}}" will be moved to the archive. It can be restored from settings.

session.title: Session
session.agenda_placeholder: What was discussed / what is planned to discuss…
session.empty: No sessions yet. Add the first meeting — a card will appear here.

notes.title: Notes
notes.delete_confirm: This note will be deleted. A record of its deletion will remain in the timeline.
notes.already_deleted_nothing: Note already deleted — nothing to open

anamnesis.title: Anamnesis
anamnesis.description: All subfields are optional. Multiple anamneses per client are fine: each new snapshot appears in the timeline separately.
anamnesis.date_required: Specify the date the anamnesis was taken
anamnesis.delete_confirm: This anamnesis will be deleted permanently.

protocol.title: Session protocol
protocol.description: All fields are optional. One protocol per meeting; saving again updates the existing one.
protocol.error_empty: Fill in at least one field
protocol.delete_confirm: The protocol of this meeting will be deleted permanently.
protocol.cannot_find_meeting: Could not determine the protocol's meeting

placeholder.summary: What was discussed, key topics, important moments
placeholder.homework: What the client should do before the next meeting
placeholder.plan_next: What we plan to focus on

revision.title: Change of field "{{field}}"
revision.hint: To change the current value of the field, edit it in the right panel — this will create a new revision. A historical record can only be deleted.
revision.delete_confirm: This history record will be deleted. If it is the last one for the field, the current value will roll back to the previous one.

security.change_password_description: Re-encrypts the database with the new password. Already created backups will still open with the old password.
security.weak_password_reason: The current password does not meet the new requirements (minimum {{min}} characters).
security.kdf_upgrade_reason: Password protection will be upgraded to a stronger algorithm (Argon2id) when you change the password.
security.new_password_min: New password must be at least {{min}} characters
security.autolock_description: When idle (no input or mouse movement) the app closes the database and asks for the password again. Disabled by default.
security.autolock_warning: The app is about to lock
security.autolock_warning_description: Move the mouse or press a key to stay in the session.

backup.title: Backups
backup.description: A snapshot of the encrypted database. Restore is only possible with the password in effect at the time of creation. Old copies are rotated automatically.
backup.auto_on_quit: Automatically create a backup when quitting the app
backup.export_description: All data in a single plain-text JSON file. Handy for migration or manual analysis, but requires careful storage.
backup.export_dialog_description: The file will contain client data in plain (unencrypted) form. Store it only in a secure place, encrypt it separately when transferring. Delete after use.
backup.restore_confirm: The current database will be replaced with the selected backup and the app will restart. You will need the password in effect when the backup was created.
backup.restore_extra: A safety copy of the current database will be kept in the backups folder (pre-restore-…).

trash.description: Archived clients can be restored or deleted permanently. Permanent deletion removes all the client's meetings, notes and anamneses in cascade.
trash.purge_confirm: Client "{{name}}" will be deleted permanently along with meetings, notes and anamneses.
trash.empty_confirm: All {{count}} archived clients will be deleted permanently.

colors.description: Each note can be tagged with a color from the palette. Each color has a text badge label.
colors.label: Label
colors.delete_confirm: Color "{{label}}" will be removed from the palette.
colors.replace_description: {{count}} notes are tagged with this color. Choose a replacement — or remove the color from these notes.

presets.description: This list is used for autocomplete in the "Medications" field on the client page. Custom values entered on the client page are not added here automatically — add them manually.
presets.name: Name
presets.delete_confirm: Preset "{{name}}" will be deleted. Values already saved for clients are not affected.

medications.no_presets: No matching presets. Type a name and press Enter to add it as custom.
